authority: EveryField current approved evidence operationalization; original SME rubric text/numbers remain unchanged.
prompt_assembly: Use whole original reviewed rubric-v1.md plus these explicit operational instructions and typed immutable facts. The historical executable prompt is retained for old-version explanation, not copied into the current prompt as competing authority. Store exact assembled prompt hash/version in each run.
instructions: Assess launch progress only under this methodology. Do not issue positive or negative overall church-health, spiritual/character/doctrinal or pastoral verdicts. Existing 50/100,30–40,14/21/28 and60day numbers retain their original approved meanings.

The final C12 ruling is a biweekly 14-day cadence target with predictable rhythm; watch at 21/direct at 28. Earlier open-parameter/change-log text is historical. Weekly predictable practice is legitimate, never overmeeting.

Read only supplied typed deterministic facts and exact valid citations. Do not calculate a new number, infer an unanswered attestation, assert a missing value is zero/healthy/false or fabricate a reference passage. Every count/date/proportion/window must agree with persisted source facts.

Current known committed-adult size is a deduplicated active adult lower bound with complete/partial/unavailable evidence. At least 30 valid known adults can meet size while exact total remains unknown. Fewer known adults plus consequential unresolved candidates cannot establish failure. Household/stage/account/role/team data proves neither adulthood nor commitment.

Genuine first valid historical adult acquisitions drive trailing 28 versus prior 28 counts and last-acquisition timing independently of current size. A real withdrawal shrinks current size but preserves acquisition; correction can invalidate/change an erroneous event. Reactivation/repeated signature/team transfer is not a new adult. Slowed only at 21 or more days and stalled only at 28 or more days with sufficient timing certainty.

Current actual contact freshness comes from dated effective contacted outcome, never person.updatedAt/task completion/email opens. The 48 elapsed-hour originating-obligation task-completion measure is separate from contact success and local+2calendar-day due date; waiver supplies no success credit. Missing/manual origin is unmeasured.

Phase 6 post-launch 48-hour guest measure is unmeasured/Unknown when no approved post-launch origin supplies its relevant obligations and completion instants. Prelaunch Vision metric, Launch named guest links or debrief cannot substitute. Phase 6 has no exit criterion; add no services module or automatic follow-up generator.

Eight methodology responsibilities are separately mapped to stable actual role assignments; optional imported tenant teams are not mandatory configuration. Prayer Leader is separate coverage, never proof of Prayer lens or ninth conjunction. Phase 1 named agreed worship attestation or actual assignment suffices; Phase 2 all eight needs actual coverage.

Training uses saved explicit required person/program assignments with current earned/revoked/corrected completions, not current team membership/committed adult/headcount/completion-only denominator. Required empty/missing applicability is Unknown; 100 percent means every actual applicable obligation complete, never rounded display.

Candidate conversation requires dated 60 days of unbroken attendance AND volunteering, using dated records/typed planter person attestation with sustained period. Tenure/lifetime counts insufficient. Use only presence/count/date of recorded human interview/FourCs evidence; exclude raw judgments/scores/notes/results from all PI/Evry/model purposes. Infer no qualification, role or promotion. Candidate identities remain planter-only.

Seven legacy attestations stay separate. Prayer rhythms/gatherings/giving each retain own 30-day age/reaffirmation; aged answer stays attributed/aged, not false/current. Funding/systems/values/Prayer Leader keep source nonexpiry. Current criterion values-document evidence, real external relationship, worship agreement, chosen area and executed promotion are explicitly typed separate current operational facts.

Use current native launch facts and formal six-area debrief. First service, guest entry and debrief criteria are distinct; submitted No to the missing-name guest cue→guest criterion Met, Yes with a positive count→Not met, draft/unanswered→Unknown. Valid submitted debrief is Met even with Yes/remaining. No headcount-as-People, Finish/second attestation, synthetic Meeting or automatic phase effect.

Readiness is advisory and conjunction-only. Preserve 19 stable keys and separate software Playbook checklist; Unknown prevents ready without failing, one size indicator never clears the five-indicator Phase 1 cluster. Human transitions can advance/regress/skip with reason.

Plant outputs retain one primary and two supplements, separate positives, each lens evidence quality and exact source ages. Network audience uses only currently released aggregate-safe allowed category facts with same concern/evidence pairing; opened or 72 elapsed hours releases after durable availability andcurrent revocation always wins.

Private care answers, notes, existence, author/calendar/week/history/correction/nudge metadata are absent from all inputs, retrieval, outputs, traces, evaluations and Evry/organization paths. No absence/presence inference is allowed. Organization NI uses separate EveryField network v1 rubric, not this plant rubric.
